summary: Round 3: the geometry is identical to round 2 (same part volumes, walls and requirement values in report.json), so the round-2 engineering conclusions stand. Every joint stops at about -2 deg, flexion is clear to 80/80/70, the pivots are ground-shoulder screws, and both FEA cases pass (4.6 and 10.5 MPa vs 24). The round-2 doc and BOM items are fixed in DESIGN.md and bom (side play stated, insert flush-to-low, ~0.5 N m torque, McMaster 97505A106 link). The remaining issues are minor: the generated ASSEMBLY.md the owner will follow does not carry those instructions, plus two accepted geometry nits.

findings.issue: The owner-facing build sheet still has 'Tools: none', no insert heat-set step, no flush-to-low instruction, no torque limit (each pivot line says 'tighten until the shoulder bottoms'), and no tendon threading / crimp-sleeve steps. The BOM note still says 'tighten fully'. The correct procedure exists only in DESIGN.md s9, so someone working from ASSEMBLY.md can leave an insert proud (clamping the joint, which has only 0.15 mm of head play) or pull an insert whose mouth wall to the extensor groove is ~0.2 mm.
findings.fix: Have the generator include the project's assembly notes (e.g. an `assembly.notes`/per-step text field in project.yaml, or append DESIGN s9), list the tools (soldering iron with insert tip, flat plate, small slotted driver, crimper), and add a 'light torque' note for shoulder pivots into heat-set inserts. That is a general engine improvement, not a one-project patch.

findings.issue: Side play is unchanged in geometry: 0.45 mm axial, ~1.7 deg tilt per joint, a few mm of fingertip wobble. It is now documented in DESIGN s2 with remedies (4.2 mm hole after a test pair, or a 0.2 mm PTFE washer under the head, which cuts the play to 0.25 mm without clamping).
findings.fix: Accept as documented, or apply the 4.2 mm hole after the test print.

findings.issue: Cosmetic cusp where the pocket circle cuts the child's top-band lug (documented in DESIGN). It is not on the load path.
findings.fix: Optional: start the lug at z = RH in the top band.

findings.issue: The wall check still reports 1.12 mm (p2), below the 1.2 mm reliable minimum, at the knot pockets / grooves.
findings.fix: Move the pockets or channel 0.1-0.2 mm.

findings.issue: Knuckle-face grooves are built from 10-deg steps (serrated fan). A taut 0.5 mm line stays inside the tube union per the STEP comment; a slack or 0.8 mm line may drag on the ridges.
findings.fix: Acceptable. Use a single swept groove if the line frays in testing.
